content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Resubmission would not correct the authorization defect, another appeal is not supported without a new denial on the table, and billing the patient for an authorization failure would be improper. Human specialist review is the only available action that can properly assess any remaining payer-specific exception or contractual remedy."}
